originality.rationale: The exact Student marginals, attained Kantorovich angular minimax sign probability, high-condition transition, and harmonic reciprocal-Pareto tail coefficient are not supplied by the full inspected 2026 method paper, nor implied by the deterministic/sketch-corrected prior work. Classical Gaussian sample-correlation and general quadratic-ratio moment theories can cover component statistical phenomena, and those are not claimed independently original. Earlier sketched negative-Ritz observations are acknowledged as prior, not claimed new. Detailed searches of the published mathematical record and own accessible claims found no stronger covering statement; priority risk from algebraically equivalent Gaussian-ratio and sample-correlation literature remains, especially Roberts (1995), whose abstract but not full text was read.
residual_risks: Classical bivariate Gaussian sample-correlation laws and Roberts (1995) general quadratic-ratio moment theorems may already imply component facts, particularly the nonexistence of harmonic moments. Roberts full text was not accessible, so that comparison is unresolved; novelty rests on the specific sharp SPD conditioning reliability frontier and quantitative harmonic constant, not the general statistical phenomena.
The projection-level conclusions do not extend without proof to fully restarted algorithms or to sketch realizations passing a deterministic embedding test.
Unconditional scalar Gaussian behavior is distinct from established conditional sufficient conditions.
